To prevent memory leaks, the implementation of SensorAdapterDetach function must release the private WINBIO_SENSOR_CONTEXT structure pointed to by the SensorContext member of the pipeline, as well as any other resources attached to the sensor context. If the SensorContext field in the pipeline object is NULL when this function is called, it indicates the pipeline was not properly initialized and must return WINBIO_E_INVALID_DEVICE_STATE to notify the Windows Biometric Framework. Before returning S_OK, this function must set the SensorContext field of WINBIO_PIPELINE structure to NULL. Since this function is called after removing storage and engine adapters from the pipeline, its implementation must not call any functions referenced by WINBIO_ENGINE_INTERFACE or WINBIO_STORAGE_INTERFACE structures pointed to by EngineInterface and StorageInterface members. The SensorHandle member of WINBIO_PIPELINE structure remains valid after SensorAdapterDetach call and can be used to access sensor device if needed. entities.description: Windows 生物识别框架中传感器适配器接口结构体。定义传感器适配器与Windows生物识别框架之间的接口。

entities.name: PWINBIO_SENSOR_INTERFACE
entities.description: 指向 WINBIO_SENSOR_INTERFACE 结构体的指针，包含 SensorInterface、EngineInterface 和 StorageInterface 成员。

members.name: Version
members.description: 此结构的版本号。 Windows 10：必须WINBIO_SENSOR_INTERFACE_VERSION_3版本号。 Windows Server 2012 R2、Windows 8.1、Windows Server 2012 和 Windows 8：版本 号必须WINBIO_SENSOR_INTERFACE_VERSION_2。 Windows Server 2008 R2 和 Windows 7： 版本号必须

entities.name: PWINIBIO_SENSOR_CONTEXT
entities.description: Pointer to a WINIBIO_SENSOR_CONTEXT structure. Used in WinBio adapter context for sensor operations.

entities.name: FrameworkInterface
entities.description: Windows生物识别框架接口，每个生物识别单元都有自己独特的WINBIO_PIPELINE结构，用于维护生物识别单元执行的操作的当前处理状态。框架会自动将管道结构的地址传递给组件堆栈中的每个适配器。

entities.name: PWINBIO_IDENTITY
entities.description: Pointer to WINBIO_IDENTITY structure containing biometric identity information

entities.name: IndexVector
entities.description: 包含一个ULONG数组，用于存储索引向量，以及数组的大小。

entities.name: TemplateBlob
entities.description: 包含生物识别模板数据的结构体。字段包括 TemplateBlobSize（模板大小，字节）、TemplateBlob（模板数据指针）、PayloadBlobSize（PayloadBlob 数据大小）、PayloadBlob（完整性检查数据指针）。此结构体仅由适配器用于包含嵌入式存储的可移动设备。
